description: Create or replace one encrypted, server-monitored OCO exit plan on an owned Hyperliquid or Derive position.

break_even_after_pct.description: Profit fraction that activates a break-even exit.

stop_loss_pct.description: Loss fraction from entry, e.g. 0.05 for 5%.

take_profit_pct.description: Profit fraction from entry, e.g. 0.10 for 10%.

trailing_activation_pct.description: Profit fraction required before trailing protection arms.

trailing_stop_pct.description: Trailing distance as a decimal fraction.

name: set_exit_plan
